title: Hatace Ferry
safeHtml:
Hatace Ferry, abbreviated as HF and formally known as Hatace Ferry Corporation Limited, was established on January 12 2016 as one of the founding members of Hatace International Holdings Limited. Hatace Ferry is also the largest private ferry operator in Los Sengas.

Hatace Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. It features a Nazca Railway Station featuring Stadium Line. While this island was the first island on West Metropolis Archipelago to complete development, it is currently under reconstruction.

Location[]

Hatace Island is located at the east of West Metropolis Archipelago, and is named after the fact that this island resembled a man's face wearing a hat.

Station Gauntlet[]

    • Solo
    • Codes
    • Calculation

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2.5
  • Only One Player is Required.
  • There exists two hints that are hidden behind station facilities, and then there are hints that are closely located to the Gauntlet.
  • 3 * 4 ≠ 12!
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a Red Leather Cap.

History[]

  • June 20 2015: This station began services.
  • May 19 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[2]
  • June 1 2018: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[3]
  • October 12 2018: Services at this station was suspended due to damage to the station structure.[4]
  • October 16 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]
  • January 31 2024: Exit D is added to this station to connect to the Kirameki Electric Railway Station of the Same Name.
  • February 1 2025: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[6]

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the third Cavern Station ever built, as well as the first Cavern Station to be built as an interchange station, with the first two Cavern Stations being Long Bay Station and Lorepine Station.[2]
  • At the time of this station's construction, the Prospektious Line Platforms were not yet marked with its colored wool.
  • This station is the first station in Nazca Railway at which the Platform Screen Door Controls are hung from the ceiling instead of suspended from the floor.[3]
  • The Chinese Pronounciation of this Station is provided at the large Next Station Signs of each platform due to the rarity of the Chinese Words used in this station. However, according to the Peckern North Developer, the Chinese Words of the name of this station is used to commemorate the Tin Kum-Shek Pai Tau New Town behind the mountain of this station, which in turn is the namesake of the "Tin Shek New Town Development Road" near this station.
  • The Cavern Space of this station has enough water capacity to fill 300 Standard Olympic Pools.[4]
  • While Everchord Line has a larger line number than Prospektious Line, as the arrival of Everchord Line to this station was confirmed earlier than the arrival of Prospektious Line to this station, the platform numbers for Everchord Line in this station is smaller than that for Prospektious Line.
  • Cavern Tunnels are seen at both ends of Arcgo Line and Prospektious Line. A design similar to that of the Arcgo Line cavern tunnels would also be used at Candor Plains Station.
  • The layout of Relish Island pays tribute to the shape of the Station Control Room of this station.

Future Development[]

  • Everchord Line will extend in the Up Direction from Ramseqeu Station to this station.

History[]

  • August 6 2021: This Station began construction.
  • August 9 2021: This station began services alongside Arcgo Line, but Prospektious Line and Everchord Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • January 31 2023: This station completed setting up of Prospektious Line systems.[5]At the same day, Prospektious Line is established.
  • August 10 2026: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[6]

Hawthorn Station is a station on Stadow Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Jupiter. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nawis Railway Labyrinth Line (Hawthorn Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is sister stations with Zenoridge Station.
  • This station shares structure with Nawis Railway Hawthorn Station.
  • Due to the fact that the concourse is located closer to the Nawis Railway Hawthorn Station, the corridor outside the gate area is narrower than that of Zenoridge Station.[2]
  • This station provides the only means of access between the Ground Level and the Nawis Railway Hawthorn Station as that station does not have any exits on the ground level on its own.

History[]

  • November 9 2022: This Station completed construction.[3]
  • November 10 2022: This Station began services.

title: Hawynveil
safeHtml:
Hawynveil is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Central South Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-11.

Contents

History[]

According to Histrocial Documents, there used to be two large families in the Brighton Hall area who had bitter rivalries with each other, with one being the Poon Family who helped create the namesake of Brighton Hall, and the other being the Wan Family. Eventually, the Wan Family lost the rivalry, and escaped to the area that is now known as Holborn Garden. In order to leave proof of existance of the Wan Family, as well as to leave a veil of deception over the true origins of the name, a Welsh-sounding name "Hawynveil" was used. The name of "Holborn Garden" also originated from one of the Wan Family Elders, Holborn Wan.

Hawynveil has one of the highest proportions of private housing in any Sub-District of Asylum at 47%. This was due to the fact that this area was adjacent to the southernmost exit of Route 3, and the convenience of Road Transport also attracted many potential buyers.

Future Development[]

The current developer of Asylum will continue to collaborate with the developer of Coopol regarding Fubuki development, and has also considered the possibility of Additional Housing along the border of the two Districts.

History[]

The name of this Sub-District originates from a Chess Grandmaster who used Hazel as the main material for his Game Boards.

History[]

  • April 23 2016: This station began operations.
  • 2019: This station was temporary closed due to Deepond Light Rail reformation.
  • End of 2019: This station was reopened with operation of Line 1.
  • August 20 2022: The outer ring rail of this station began operation.
  • May 27 2025: This station ceased operations.

Fun Facts[]

  • When this station was operational, only the Inner Ring Direction of Line 1 stopped at this station.
  • The former English name of the station was Bulldoze Shoal Station, alluding to Bulldoze Island Station. However, the island owner misspelled "推" (Push) to "堆" (Heap). Therefore the English of this station was changed to current name.
  • This station used to "compete" with Star Pond Station for the transfer of Line 3.
  • After this station ceased operations, it was repurposed as the Heaping Shoal Sidings.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is named after a Heart-shaped river to the east of this station.
  • The North End of the Abyss Line Platforms in this station are curved.

History[]

  • January 20 2017: This station completed construction.[3]
  • January 21 2017: This station began services alongside East Ring Line.
  • March 30 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.
  • March 31 2018: The Abyss Line part of this station completed expansion.
  • April 3 2018: Abyss Line is established.

Heaven Pacific Station was a station on Forward Line. It was operated by Nazca Railway (Heaven Pacific Division) before the closure of that division, and was located in Heaven Pacific. While this station had plans to serve Upward Line, as the Heaven Pacific Division closed before it could be built, the plans never came to fruition.

title: Heeled Island Stabling Sidings
safeHtml:
Heeled Island Stabling Sidings is the first stabling sidings in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division constructed for West Ring Line. It is located beneath Heeled Island Station, and is designed to support Miner Bay Depot.

Contents

  • 1 Description
    • 1.1 Sidings
    • 1.2 Connecting Tracks
    • 1.3 Other Facts
  • 2 Citations and References

Description[]

Sidings[]

The two sides have 18 sidings in total.

Connecting Tracks[]

The two ends of the stabling sidings connect to West Ring Line, with access to this Stabling Siding through a spur to the south of Heeled Island Station.

Other Facts[]

This Stabling Sidings was built simultaneously with Miner Bay Depot, and Heeled Island Station also has longer platforms due to this Stabling Sidings.

  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a pair of iron boots.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station has the longest pair of platforms in West Metropolis Archipelago, and has the third longest platform in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division at 304m (The longest platform is at Swamp One Station at 906m).
  • The Heeled Island Stabling Sidings is located at both sides beneath this station.
  • The Station Gauntlet of this station alludes to the Room 14D in the Pitfalls Video of the Kane Pixels Backrooms.

History[]

  • May 15 2015: This station began services.
  • April 7 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[2]
  • March 20 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[3]
  • June 27 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • August 14 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]
  • March 15 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • June 6 2023: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.
  • December 4 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[6]

Helios Pier North Stop is a station of SLT Line 3512. It is located at Los Sengas Odyssey. This station will serve Line 3511 in the future.

Contents

Fun Facts[]

  • While the platform signs of this station states the Station Name of Tremendous, the actual Tremendous Stop is located on Line 3501 near Fishpond Vale instead.
  • While this station has yet to be officially named, the name is used as a placeholder due to the fact that it is located to the north of Helios Pier Stop.
  • While there is no concrete evidence that this line will Serve Line 3511 in the future, as there is a reserved platform for Line 3511 in Helios Pier Stop, and there aren't any separate tracks for Line 3511 leaving that stop, it is implied that Line 3511 will serve this staiton in the future. However, it should also be noted that the branch to the north of this Station to Hysan Place indicates Line 3513 instead of Line 3511. Therefore, the reserved platform at Helios Pier may be allocated for Line 3513 instead of Line 3511 as indicated.

Helios Station is a station on Phoenix Line, Odyssey Circular and Golf Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Odyssey. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 3511, Line 3512 (Hysan Place Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first station to be built in Odyssey after the establishment of Odyssey as a district.[3]
  • This Station, as well as Helios, is named as a sarcasm of the Sun Entertainment Culture Limited, a former Hong Kong-based entertainment company, and is NOT related to Helios, the Sun God in Greek Mythology of the same name. However, currently, this name is only reserved due to historical reasons.
  • While the proper pronounciation of this station is /ˈheɪliɒs/ ("Hey-li-os"), it is usually mispronounced as /ˈhiːliɒs/ ("He-li-os").

History[]

  • July 6 2023: This Station began construction.
  • July 12 2023: This Station completed construction. At the same day, this station began services alongside Phoenix Line, but Odyssey Circular and Golf Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • November 2 2024: This station completed setting up of Golf Line systems.
  • November 3 2024: Golf Line extends from Fishpond Vale Station to this station.
  • February 19 2025: This station completed setting up of Odyssey Circular systems.[4]
  • February 22 2025: Odyssey Circular is established.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is built to cater for the villagers that live in the vicinity of this station. The hexagonal skylight at the concourse is built as per the request of the local developer.[2]
  • The color Purple is used in this station to correspond to the Chinese name of this station as purple is usually considered to be the sixth color of a rainbow when indigo is not considered.[3]

History[]

  • February 10 2021: This station completed construction.[4]
  • February 11 2021: This station began services.

Higashi-Peckern Coast = Station was a planned station on Southern Peck Line. It would have been operated by Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu, and would have been located in Los Sengas Peckern. However, due to changes in development plans, this station was never built.

Fun Facts[]

  • While the plans for Southern Peck Line were scrapped, the section between Yakumo Estate Station and Nishi-Blu Trove Bay Station became a part of the Peckern South-East Coast Line. The Station corresponding to this station on Peckern South-East Coast Line is East Peckern Coast Station. In Fact, the predecessor of East Peckern Coast Station is this station, as this station also used the structure that East Peckern Coast Station currently uses.

Station Souvenir Hints (Now Demolished)[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.

  • Stars: 2
  • 2 players and/or 2 entities required
  • Find the pressure plates at the platforms
  • Once you can see the open door, enter it, and you will get it.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of an Oak Door.

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • If you can't see the obstacle ahead from this angle, try another angle.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a Dark Oak Door.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the second Area Station to be built in Los Sengas Division.
  • The Swift Line expansion part of this station adopts a similar building material scheme to that of Coast Edge Station. Therefore, instead of Black Wool, Red Terracotta is used as the complimentary building material of that part.

History[]

  • March 18 2015: This station began services alongside West Ring Line.
  • January 28 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[3]
  • May 9 2016: This station completed replacement of Station Name Banner.[4]
  • December 14 2016: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[5]
  • January 22 2017: This station completed replacement of Welcome signs.[6]
  • February 24 2017: The Departure Routine has upgraded from Generation II to Generation III.[7]
  • March 30 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[8]
  • January 11 2021: This station began and completed expansion. During the expansion, nine exits, one concourse and a set of Island Platforms are added for Swift Line.
  • January 12 2021: Swift Line extends from Vincere Road Station to this station.
  • January 31 2021: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[9]
  • February 3 2022: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[10]

Station Souvenir Hints (Now Inaccessible)[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.

  • Stars: 1-2 (Dependent on the Parkour Skills of the player)
  • Look for openings of Gold Blocks which you can jump up to from ground level.
  • Once you reach the highest point, walk along the glass.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a block of stone.

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Solo
    • Ascension
    • Regret

Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1.5~2 (Depending on your Parkour Skills)
  • Only One player is required.
  • Before ascending the tower, it is advised for you to look around the tower to avoid regrets of walking the extra mile later on.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of Andesite.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Station Souvenir building of this station is located between the northbound and southbound lanes of Route 1, whereas the station is located directly beneath it.
  • The Urban Line Platforms of this station alludes to Mong Kok East Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.

History[]

  • May 24 2015: This station began services alongside Urban Line. Urban Line is established.
  • May 27 2015: East Ring Line extends from Cyan Loop Station to this station.
  • May 6 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • July 13 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • July 22 2020: The Urban Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[6]
  • August 29 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[7]
  • December 8 2023: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.

title: High Speed Railway
safeHtml:
High Speed Railway (Formally named Nazca Railway Terracept Division High Speed Railway) was the Intercity Rail system of NR. It was established on October 16 2013 alongside Austrumcept Terminal. At the time of the closure of Terracept Division, there was only one High Speed Railway Line in operation.

Contents

  • 1 Facilities
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 List of High Speed Railway Stations
  • 4 Citations and References

Facilities[]

For each High Speed Railway station, there would be an arrival hall and a departure hall. As their names suggest, the departure hall is used for passengers entering high speed railway trains, whereas the arrival hall is for passengers arriving at the high speed railway station. Departure Halls feature a cafe and a luggage drop-off area, with a map that highlights the entire High Speed Railway system and instructs the passengers which platform to board to go to a certain destination.

On the other hand, the arrival hall features conveyor belts at which passengers could collect their luggage in a fashion similar to airport arrival halls.

Fun Facts[]

  • While only one High Speed Railway line was ever established between Terracept and Austrumcept, as there are 10 platforms and 6 platforms dedicated to the High Speed Railway for the former and latter respectively, it could be implied that this system was expected to undergo large-scale expansions and involve more stations. However, due to the closure of Terracept Division, the plans for other lines in the High Speed Railway Network never came to fruition.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Of Soil and Splendor, Of Jest and Joy".

Fun Facts[]

  • While the Original Color Scheme of this station was meant to be either yellow or green,[2] in order to Pay tribute to Citizen News, a now-defunct Online News Website based in Hong Kong, a Station Art resembling the icon of Stand News is also built above the Cometsilk Line Platforms of this Station. This arrangement is similar to that of Apple Hill Station and Markost Station, and the color scheme of this station also alludes to Citizen News, with the logo representing multiple people.
  • Due to geological issues, the New Edward Line Platforms leans to the south to avoid mountainous terrain. Moreover, while the Cometsilk Line Orientation only uses half of the platform length, the New Edward Line orientation uses the full platform length.
  • This Station is the first station to be built in 2022.
  • This Station is Sister Stations with Arrowhead Station.

History[]

  • January 5 2022: This Station began construction.
  • January 6 2022: The Station Structure of this Station copmleted construction.[3]
  • January 8 2022: This Station completed construction. At the same day, this station began services alongside Cometsilk Line, but New Edward Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • February 1 2022: New Edward Line extended from Nail Bight Checkpoint to this station through Shatterpass Station.
  • April 3 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • January 17 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[4]
  • August 7 2025: The Station Icon of this station is added.

Fun Facts[]

  • The English name of this station (Hillly Strings) has three small letter 'l's in a fashion similar to Taiiin Hill Station in Terracept Division. The three 'l's is an imagery of piano keys.
  • The Chinese name of this station (上弦山) is identical with Upward Line Quatina Hill Station in Heaven Pacific, although that station never existed as Heaven Pacific was closed before the station could had been built.
  • The decoration and color scheme of this station resembles a Grand Piano. However, for the Platform levels, the ratio of black color increases with the platform depth.
  • This station features a four-floored elevator similar to the one in Nazca Railway Vertow Valley Station.
  • The station number of Evillow Line for this station was EV-18. However, it has later been changed to EV-20 due to Station Number rearrangements.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station alludes to Che Kung Temple Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.[2]
  • All Sava Line Stations between Savanna Central Station and this station, besides of North Mountain Station, The Three Pass Station and Southend Station, do NOT feature Station Facilities as Sava Line is a line that is designed for lower ridership and civilian use. However, these stations all feature NR Shops.
  • The length of Platform 1 of this station increased from 152m to 223m after standardization.

History[]

  • July 7 2016: This station began construction.[3]
  • July 8 2016: This Station began services. Sava Line is established.
  • October 18 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • February 18 2024: The Platform Gates of this station are installed.
  • February 18 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]
